extra.final_summary: Average flipper length by species (65 of 67 rows used): Adelie ≈ 189.71 mm, Chinstrap ≈ 195.73 mm, Gentoo ≈ 217.81 mm. Data problems found: flipper_length_mm had 2 impossible negative values (rows 9 and 48: -185 and -212 mm), outside the rules' valid range of 170–235 mm; those rows were excluded with approval. No duplicate rows, and species labels were already clean (Adelie/Chinstrap/Gentoo). Caveat: the two excluded rows were both otherwise valid records, so their species' averages are based on slightly fewer penguins (Adelie 34, Gentoo 16, Chinstrap 15).
